About

I'm a final-year Computer Engineering student at Firat University, focused on embedded systems and low-level software.

⌖ Elazig, Turkey

In summer 2026 I did two internships. At the T3 Foundation Deneyap Kart Unit we moved a VTOL UAV from Pixhawk to the T3 Gemstone O1; I did the wiring, receiver integration and calibration, and the aircraft made its first flight on the board. In the same internship I wrote the subsystem software of a mapping robot and prepared example projects and a Fritzing part for Deneyap Kart. At Repkon I selected a board for vibration anomaly detection and wrote embedded software that detects anomalies in real time, then built a Raspberry Pi 5 monitoring app that supports 12 different ST sensor boards.

Most of my experience with STM32 and ESP32 firmware, peripheral integration, power management and system architecture comes from TEKNOFEST teams. I am interested in autonomous systems, the defense industry, robotics and embedded software.
